title: AI inbox: new things now float, important things stay up

owner_note.text: Merged. rank = importance + recency boost: under 30 min old floats to the top (and the score floor no longer hides it), then a small tail decays over 24 h; unread owner notes stay pinned at 100; opened rows sink, archived are last. Demo with the debug score list: /framework/ux/Inbox/ ; formula: public/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/doc/ranking.md ; shots in the task's shots/ dir. I also made a 2-line change in ai/rail/inbox.js so the live AI inbox sorts by Inbox.rank.
